caption:
By the end of 2025, 3.6 million Sudanese had fled to just seven neighbouring countries.

Watch the exodus spread: the first wave follows the war erupting in Khartoum in 2023, then a new route opens to Libya, and the fall of El Fasher pushes the numbers higher again.

📊 See Sudanese refugees and asylum-seekers by country of asylum from 2015 to 2025 in this animated flow map. Explore how a decade of displacement became the fastest-growing refugee crisis on earth — the seven countries shown hold 96% of all Sudanese refugees.

Source: UNHCR Refugee Data Finder (api.unhcr.org, extracted September 2026).
